author: cosmicbatty
body:
Why hello there! I wonder if any of you even remember me... hmmm. Well, first I would like to apologize for sudden absence as I wanted to stay focused on improving my art more than anything. Things have also been going on out in the real world... eh.

Anyway I'll be joining you guys again soon enough <333
if you would like to contact me you can find me on my deviantart http://mama--bat.deviantart.com/
or on my tumblr http://mama--bat.tumblr.com/
I also stream my art through out the day or the week, it's never consistent but keep your eyes peeled!
Hope to see you soon!
-
Mama Bat
